answer_1.quote: We propose a model named Dual-Interaction-based Multimodal Summarizer (DIMS) ... the multimodal generator generates the textual summary and extracts the cover image ... The goal is to generate a textual summary Y that successfully grasp the main points of the article and choose a frame picture C that covers the gist of the video.
datasets: Weibo VMSMO dataset (large-scale news article-summary dataset with video-cover)
answer_1.outputs: textual summary (abstractive) and video cover frame

answer_2.quote: The quality of generated textual summary is evaluated by standard full-length Rouge F1 ... The quality of chosen cover frame is evaluated by mean average precision (MAP) and recall at position (R n @k).

answer_4.quote: Our first evaluation study quantified the degree to which summarization models retain key information ... participants ... The second evaluation estimated the overall quality of the textual summaries by asking participants to rank them according to its Informativeness, Coherence, and Succinctness.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators answered QA questions based on system summaries and ranked summaries on Informativeness, Coherence, and Succinctness.
